title: XMind: Thinking Twice via Cross-Memory Reasoning for LLM-Based Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.32209v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory-augmented large language model (LLM) driving agents can reuse past experience, yet previously learned corrections often fail to transfer when traffic conditions change. A key limitation is that existing memories mainly record observed outcomes, providing little evidence about alternative actions. We introduce XMind, a training-free framework that enables LLM-based driving to "Think Twice" through cross-memory reasoning. XMind integrates working memory of recent traffic states with episodic memory of critical risk events. The agent first makes an initial decision from the current context and then cross-checks it against retrieved historical experience. If a conflict arises, it makes a second decision guided by the retrieved evidence. To construct reliable episodic memory, XMind evaluates alternative actions through counterfactual rollouts under perturbed traffic conditions and stores the verified outcomes as structured risk capsule

translated_title: XMind：通过跨记忆推理实现基于大语言模型自动驾驶的“三思而后行”
translated_abstract: 基于记忆增强的大语言模型（LLM）驾驶智能体可以复用过往经验，然而当交通状况发生变化时，先前学到的纠正经验往往难以迁移。一个关键局限在于，现有记忆主要记录观察到的结果，几乎无法为替代动作提供证据支持。我们提出了XMind，这是一个无需训练的框架，通过跨记忆推理使基于LLM的自动驾驶能够“三思而后行”。XMind将近期交通状态的工作记忆与关键风险事件的情景记忆相结合。智能体首先根据当前上下文做出初始决策，然后将其与检索到的历史经验进行交叉验证。如果出现冲突，智能体将根据检索到的证据做出第二次决策。为了构建可靠的情景记忆，XMind通过在扰动交通条件下的反事实推演来评估替代动作，并将验证后的结果存储为结构化的风险胶囊。
tldr: XMind是一个无需训练的框架，通过将近期交通状态的工作记忆与基于反事实推演构建的情景记忆相结合进行跨记忆推理，使基于大语言模型的自动驾驶智能体在初始决策与历史经验冲突时能够“三思而后行”，做出更可靠的二次决策。
en_tdlr: XMind is a training-free framework that enables LLM-based autonomous driving agents to "Think Twice" via cross-memory reasoning, integrating working memory of recent traffic states with episodic memory built from counterfactual rollouts to make a more reliable second decision when the initial decision conflicts with retrieved historical experience.
